plan.title: fix(literal-acceptance): refuse acceptance cwd and npm --prefix inside node_modules

narratives.Description: This story adds refusals to the literal acceptance cwd and npm --prefix checks. A cwd or --prefix value with a node_modules segment or a leading-dot segment is refused at grammar time, and a resolved real path with a node_modules segment is refused at run time. Acceptance commands then run only from the repo's own directories, never from installed dependencies.
narratives.Overview:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A literal acceptance command whose record cwd has a `node_modules` path segment or a leading-dot segment is refused at grammar time (`evaluateAcceptanceCwdGrammar`).
- [ ] An `npm --prefix` value with a `node_modules` segment or a leading-dot segment is refused (`evaluateCommandSafety`).
- [ ] `evaluateAcceptanceCwdContainment` refuses a resolved real path that contains a `node_modules` segment, for both the cwd and the `--prefix` directory.
- [ ] Regression tests in `packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/` cover each refusal, and the brief-command survey reports how many existing brief commands change verdict.
- [ ] `content/docs/plan-acceptance.md` states that acceptance commands run only from the repo's own directories, never from installed dependencies.

Refs #7175, #7220
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer whose briefs carry literal acceptance commands, I want activation and verify:ac to refuse an acceptance cwd or npm --prefix inside node_modules or a dot folder, so that an acceptance run never executes code from installed dependencies.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. In packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/safety.ts, make evaluateAcceptanceCwdGrammar refuse (not warn) a cwd with a node_modules segment or a leading-dot segment, with its own refusal id and reason; other non-grammar cwds keep today's warning.
2. In evaluateCommandSafety, refuse an npm --prefix value (both --prefix <dir> and --prefix=<dir>) with a node_modules segment or a leading-dot segment.
3. In packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/run.ts, make evaluateAcceptanceCwdContainment refuse a resolved real path that has a node_modules segment relative to the real project root; evaluateRunContainment applies it to the cwd and to the --prefix directory.
4. Carry the new grammar refusal through the record verdict consumers (product-first-done-gate evaluate.ts, the activation acceptance gate, runtime verify-ac.ts) and declare the refusal id in refusal-declarations/table.ts.
5. Add regression tests under packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/ for each refusal; run a one-off survey of existing brief acceptance commands and report in the PR how many change verdict.
6. Update content/docs/plan-acceptance.md to state that acceptance commands run only from the repo's own directories, never from installed dependencies; add one changelog.d fragment; regenerate RULE-MAP, PROJECT-DEFINITION, evaluator-surface disposition and the spec-drift row only if the build changes them.
